issues: known-invalid decode: profile declares signed; unsigned 0xFFFF became 2,047.97 V. Sentinel/negative values now decode to None, not a voltage

known-invalid decode: 40/40 responses are 03FE; byte 1 x 100 gives 25,400 ppm, whole u16 gives 1,022 ppm, and 03FE is also the BMS not-fitted sentinel. 03FE now decodes to None; a non-sentinel 16-bit scale is still unconfirmed
known-invalid decode: bytes 3-4 are the complement of the real current in bytes 1-2 (sum ~0x0508), not an independent current; raw-only, use dcdc_gw_current

known-invalid decode: 10 km/LSB secondary distance counter, not the odometer: x10 matched a ~10.5 km drive and x100 is refuted. It equals the main odometer minus 99,869-99,871 km on this car, consistent with a BMS reset at ~99,870 km; service history is unavailable, so the absolute zero is still not usable for distance/SoH

known-invalid decode: the profile u16[0:2] x 15.625 - 39.5 read ~483476 degC; the decoder now uses byte 0 x 0.1 (11-13 degC, ~1.17 degC MAE versus outside) but windshield-vs-ambient still needs a cold-soak/defroster test
